executiveAssessment.text:
Executive Conclusion. Wyndham Alltra Punta Cana's primary issue is entering AI consideration at all, especially for Business Travel.

What the Data Is Telling Us. AI Consideration is 3.4%, so the hotel appears in only a limited share of individual comparable responses. When the hotel is absent, Secrets Cap Cana Resort & Spa is a leading observed alternative in those gaps — an evidence lead for review, not an automatic proof of recurring substitution. Rank tactics have limited value until relevance improves. The primary constraint is becoming part of the answer set for the traveler needs the hotel currently misses. Softest Scenario Capture is Business Travel at 0.0%. Secrets Cap Cana Resort & Spa most often appears when the hotel is missing (47 scenarios).

Why It Matters. Fine-tuning rank against individual competitors will have limited value until the hotel becomes relevant in more of the traveler needs it currently misses. Entry problems and rank problems require different management attention. If leadership optimizes competitor comparisons first, the hotel can look busy while still missing the larger answer-set gap.

Where the Pattern Is Concentrated. Business Travel is the softest Scenario Capture at 0.0%. Focus where the gap is concentrated rather than treating every territory equally. Secrets Cap Cana Resort & Spa appears most often when the hotel is missing (47 scenarios) — use that pattern for source and fact checks, not as proof of cause. Reality Coverage is 27.3% (9 of 33 attributes). Start with gaps that matter operationally — beginning with Swim-Out Suites.

What Management Should Focus On Now. Focus first on how the hotel is represented for Business Travel. Review whether the attributes, positioning, and use cases most relevant to those travelers are complete and consistently represented across priority sources. Treat competitor-rank tactics as secondary until entry improves.

What Not to Overreact To. No comparable prior official period is available — read these as current levels, not period-over-period change.

What to Review Next. Compare evidence from scenarios where Secrets Cap Cana Resort & Spa appears with the property information currently available for Wyndham Alltra Punta Cana. Check entry cues first — product type, occasion, and location framing — before broadening the review to secondary attributes.
